title: CSV is named velocity-report.csv and holds full untruncated text values
refs: SV-8646 (PV spec v10 2026-08-17 S6-R5; S6-R6; S6-R8; SV-8823 CSV plain-number/empty-null rule)
preconds: 1. You are on the Parts Velocity report with data loaded, including a part with a Description longer than 18 characters, a part with a Last Sale value, a money value over 1,000, a Margin % value, and a special-order row whose On Hand / Turns / Yr / Min / Max are empty..
steps:
1. Download the CSV and check the saved filename.
2. Open it and read the long part's Description, Category, and Vendor.
3. Read the Last Sale column value.
4. Read the money columns (Avg Cost, Avg Sell, Revenue, Margin), a value over 1,000, and the Margin % column.
5. Read the numeric cells on the special-order row that have no value (On Hand, Turns / Yr, Min, Max).
expected:
1. The file downloads as velocity-report.csv.
2. The CSV carries the FULL, untruncated Description / Category / Vendor values (unlike the PDF's 18-character cut).
3. Last Sale is a raw integer in the CSV (for example 42) — the 'N days' wording is PDF and on-screen only.
4. Every money and numeric column is written as a plain number in the CSV: no dollar sign on Avg Cost / Avg Sell / Revenue / Margin, no thousands separators on any value (a value over one thousand reads like 13544.67, not 13,544.67), and no percent sign on Margin % (it reads like 37.7, not 37.7%).
5. A numeric or money cell with no value is left EMPTY in the CSV (not an em-dash), so a spreadsheet can still total the column.
Note for the tester: the em-dash for empty values and the aligned / bold / coloured number treatment live in the PDF only; the CSV is clean, plain data.

---
This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-8582 and the Parts Velocity report specification version 11 (updated 17 August 2026, S6-R5, S6-R6, S6-R8; the CSV plain-number and empty-null rule per the Dipesh correction on SV-8823).
Last checked against build v3.8-d0e135e on 8/20/2026.
Re-checked against the live specification on 26 August 2026: the requirements this case cites are unchanged, so only the version cited above was updated.
